scripts.build:frontend: npm ci --prefix frontend/ && npm run build --prefix frontend/
scripts.ts:clean: find . -type f -name "_companion_context.js" -delete && find . -type f -name "bridge.js" -delete && find . -type f -name "_constants.js" -delete && find . -type f -name "_helpers.js" -delete && find . -type f -name "_types.js" -delete && find . -type f -name "_main.js" -delete && npm run clean:ts --prefix src-tauri/
scripts.ts:compile: npm run build --prefix packages/liatir-core && npx tsc -p tsconfig.json && npm run ts:compile --prefix src-tauri/
scripts.ts:compile:src-ts: npm run build --prefix packages/liatir-core && npx tsc -p tsconfig.json
scripts.clean:deep: npm run ts:clean && npm run clean:deep --prefix src-tauri/
scripts.build: npm install && npm run build --prefix src-tauri/
scripts.build:dev: npm install && npm run build:dev --prefix src-tauri/
scripts.build:dev:clean: npm install && npm run build:dev:clean --prefix src-tauri/
scripts.build:local: npm install && npm run build:local --prefix src-tauri/
